pages.text: Each morning, fruit was stacked at the boat front. A good stack caught passing customers' eyes.
Bung opened the fruit crate and rolled up both sleeves. "I will stack it all before customers come!"
Bung piled fruit up, up, high.
Ddori touched a fruit at the bottom. Bung worked faster.
The tower grew taller than Bung. It began to wobble.
A big boat sent waves their way. Fruit tumbled down.
Fruit rolled round the floor. A customer's boat passed by.
Mom swept a wide patch with her palm. "A wide base keeps it standing."
Bung made the bottom row wide, then slowly added one layer at a time.
The tower stood tall. Customer boats approached one by one. Bung handed over fruit.
